request.purpose: Our client launches a new drug for this condition. We want to focus our physician advertising campaign on the regions where it is most common.
request.question: What share of adults with a BMI measurement has a BMI of 30 or more, by sex?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient.
BMI 30 or more = latest BMI of 30 or higher.
Report per sex: adults with a BMI value and % with BMI 30 or more, one decimal.
